one_liner_zh: 微軟公司（MSFT）最新季度財報每股盈餘（EPS）超出預期，收入同比增長18.30%
one_liner_en: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) reported quarterly earnings with EPS beating estimates and 18.30% year-over-year revenue growth
beat_or_miss: 超預期，主要歸因於雲端服務和軟體銷售的強勁表現
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘（EPS）達4.27美元，超出預期
收入達829億美元，同比增長18.30%
雲端服務和軟體銷售表現強勁
highlights_en: Strong performance in cloud services and software sales
risks_zh: 全球經濟不確定性可能影響未來收入
競爭加劇對公司市場份額的潛在影響
risks_en: Global economic uncertainty may impact future revenue
Intensifying competition may affect the company's market share
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報顯示微軟公司的雲端服務和軟體銷售仍然強勁，對股價短中期影響為正面，追蹤指標包括未來季度的收入增長和競爭對手的動向
ai_view_en: view: the earnings report signals strong cloud services and software sales, with positive near-term implication for the stock price; key metrics to track include future revenue growth and competitors' moves
